Published baseline commit 249b3b44220bcfbd7d467de9cfc18f76e1c37807 differs from supplied input revision and live tree. Source hashes, not historical links, bind this inspection; concurrent lead changes require reread.
Decision.expression and matcher condition gating are not executable typed graph branches; merely changing visual nodes or enabling flow edges will not meet acceptance.
Legacy automations config.version can be 2 while graph.version is 1; do not conflate config format with executable graph semantic version.
WorkspaceEventBus silently drops over-limit events and swallows handler exceptions, so returned emit completion cannot acknowledge an authoritative outbox event.

RetryScheduler.generation/pendingAcks protect a single process only; post-effect crash and process restart can duplicate non-idempotent external writes unless canonical receipt/readback drives recovery.
Fencing local DB commits alone cannot undo a provider write already started by a stale worker; provider operation dedupe and unknown reconciliation must remain explicit.
History retention compacts old/malformed JSONL rows. Making these rows recovery/dedupe authority would lose required state and create false completion.
Unspecified DST repeated/skipped wall-time semantics can make preview disagree with runtime or collide occurrence IDs. Agree the contract and use the same explicit-instant computation.
Captured permissionMode or approval does not survive revoked grants; resumed effects require current server policy, cache/subscription invalidation and budget checks.

Canonical email producer, task authority, Postgres host, renderer seams and platform/provider receipts are hidden gates in the published specification. Do not add substitute stores/surfaces or mark full-domain integration N/A.
Cancel/abort cannot imply an external effect was undone; selected-step retry cannot default to replaying all irreversible nodes.
